title: O Mar Novo: «As Vagas de Nazaré»
about: The great Atlantic winter waves that break off Nazaré, on the coast of Portugal.
note: The waves off Nazaré, on the Atlantic coast of Portugal, are among the largest in the world: in winter, swells from the open ocean are funnelled by an undersea canyon and break close to the shore.
